{{Quote|Look what I found down by the stream. C'mon. Let's take the bowl outside and watch the sunset.|Telia to Hock|<ref name="Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows 5">[[Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows 5|''Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows'' 5]]</ref>}}
The [[Gender/Legends|woman]] '''Telia''' became the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of the rogue [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Hock Malsuum]] sometime after the [[Declaration of a New Order]]. She bore his child as he [[Farmer/Legends|farmed]] the land. Malsuum considered her to be a source of warmth in his life.

==Behind the scenes==
Telia appears in the comic ''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows]]''.
